description: TSA rules for melatonin supplements on planes.

carryOn.reason: Melatonin tablets and sleep supplements are fully allowed in carry-on bags without restriction. No prescription required.

checkedBag.reason: Melatonin is allowed in checked baggage.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring melatonin on a plane?

airlines.name: Singapore Airlines
airlines.notes: Melatonin pills and gummies permitted in cabin and hold baggage for personal travel.

airlines.name: Air France
airlines.notes: Permitted in cabin and checked luggage. Standard French OTC limit is 1.9mg per dose; higher doses require prescription.

airlines.name: British Airways
airlines.notes: Permitted in hand luggage. Up to 3-month personal supply permitted into the UK.

airlines.name: Japan Airlines (JAL)
airlines.notes: Melatonin is permitted in cabin baggage on JAL flights. Japan classifies melatonin as a health supplement, not a controlled drug, so no import permit is required for personal quantities.

airlines.name: Korean Air
airlines.notes: Melatonin sleep supplements are permitted in carry-on and checked baggage on Korean Air flights. South Korea does not restrict melatonin for personal use.

airlines.name: ANA (All Nippon Airways)
airlines.notes: Melatonin supplements permitted in carry-on and checked bags. No declaration required for personal quantities at Japanese customs.

Japan.reason: Melatonin is not classified as a controlled substance or designated pharmaceutical in Japan. It is sold as a health food supplement domestically and travelers may bring a personal supply for their stay. Japan Customs does not require a yakkan shoumei import certificate for melatonin. Recommended limit: up to a 1-month supply for personal use. Note: melatonin is not widely sold in Japanese pharmacies, so bring your supply from home.

South Korea.reason: Melatonin is permitted into South Korea for personal use. It is not classified as a narcotic or psychotropic substance under Korean pharmaceutical law. Travelers may bring a reasonable personal supply (up to 6 weeks) without a permit. Incheon Airport customs does not typically restrict melatonin.

UK.reason: Melatonin is prescription-only to buy in the UK, but UK Border Force and MHRA permit incoming international travelers to bring up to a 3-month personal supply.

France.reason: Melatonin supplements under 1.9mg are sold OTC in France. Personal supplies up to 3 months are permitted for travelers.

Singapore.reason: Classified as a health supplement by the Singapore Health Sciences Authority (HSA). Permitted up to 3 months for personal use without a special permit.

Australia.reason: Permitted for personal travel (up to 3 months supply). Declare if carrying commercial quantities.

faq.question: Can I bring melatonin on a plane?
faq.answer: Yes, melatonin tablets are fully allowed in carry-on and checked bags. No prescription is needed.

faq.question: Do I need to declare melatonin at customs?
faq.answer: Generally no, but check destination country rules — some countries restrict certain supplements.

faq.question: Can I bring melatonin to Japan?
faq.answer: Yes. Melatonin is not a controlled substance in Japan and does not require a yakkan shoumei import certificate. You can bring a personal supply (up to about 1 month) in your carry-on or checked bag through Narita or Haneda Airport without special permits. Note: melatonin is not commonly sold in Japanese pharmacies, so bring your supply from home.

faq.question: Can I bring melatonin to South Korea?
faq.answer: Yes. Melatonin is permitted into South Korea for personal use and is not classified as a narcotic under Korean law. You can carry it in your carry-on through Incheon Airport without a prescription or import declaration for personal quantities (up to approximately 6 weeks supply).

faq.question: Can I bring melatonin on a plane to the UK?
faq.answer: Yes. While melatonin requires a prescription to buy in UK pharmacies, UK Border Force and MHRA guidelines allow international passengers to bring up to a 3-month supply for personal use in carry-on or checked bags.

faq.question: Can you bring melatonin gummies on a plane?
faq.answer: Yes! Melatonin gummies are solid supplements and are 100% permitted in carry-on and checked luggage with zero liquid restrictions.

faq.question: Is melatonin legal in France?
faq.answer: Yes, melatonin supplements up to 1.9mg are sold over-the-counter in France. Travelers are allowed to bring their personal supply (up to 3 months) through customs.

faq.question: Can you bring melatonin into Singapore through Changi Airport?
faq.answer: Yes. Melatonin is categorized as a health supplement by the Singapore HSA. Travelers can bring up to a 3-month personal supply without prior approval.

faq.question: Can you bring melatonin on a plane in a Ziploc bag?
faq.answer: Yes, TSA does not require medication to be in original prescription containers for domestic flights. However, for international flights, keeping pills in labeled original bottles prevents customs delays.
